metadata.description: Official JieGou plugins for Claude Code — governed AI workflow automation with approval gates, audit trails, and RBAC.

plugins.name: jiegou
plugins.description: Connect Claude Code to JieGou for governed AI operations: enroll this machine as a substrate worker (console-approved work in, audited results back), plus API tools to run recipes and workflows. Your subscription does the work; the plane makes it governed.
plugins._version_note: 0.13.0 gives seats a cover-image path without cloud credentials: render_cover.py ported (brand font shipped; dual repo/plugin layout), substrate.py asset uploads bytes to the plane which does the storage write, draft-post renders + uploads + passes coverUrl. Replaces the seat-local coverPath that produced phantom cover references (2026-08-10); 0.12.0 adds the reply-draft skill: executes plane-dispatched reply-sweep-draft commands (X reply candidates -> <=278-char measured drafts, rec+alt, anti-rhyme, one B2 card per thread keyed x-reply:<statusId>, mandatory command close) — never posts to X, human sends everything; 0.11.1 duplicate-draft hardening (the DSO incident): gtm.py state surfaces the plane’s canonical externalId with an ADOPT warning on hook-dedupe redirects; draft-post skill mandates adopting it for push/gated and ALWAYS closing every pulled command via report --command (unclosed = re-dispatched = duplicate); 0.11.0 adds SSE-wake (spec 2026-08-13): substrate.py wake daemon (per-seat doorbell stream, 45s dead-connection detection, backoff reconnect, 10-min heartbeat floor) + setup_pull.py install --wake (launchd KeepAlive instead of interval polling) — dispatch→draft-start goes from up-to-30-min to ~seconds on an awake seat; 0.10.2 fixes item-less command close (report --command alone → PUT commands complete — first unattended run delivered drafts but could not close its 3 hook-dispatch commands); 0.10.1 hardens unattended pull (2026-08-13 field findings): wrapper concurrency lock (PID file — the 30-min tick no longer races a long draft session) + headless permission bootstrap at install (seat settings.json allowlist + workspace trust — without both, headless runs auto-deny every plugin-script call and execute nothing); 0.10.0 adds L1 progress-streaming (substrate.py start/progress verbs + phase-boundary skill instructions — the cockpit watches runs live); 0.9.0 adds the competitive-intel tenant plugin skill (C4 — Competitive Pulse framed by the account's own competitor set + lens, git-free plane artifact, KB-grounded, headless-safe) + gtm.py ci-recs; 0.8.0 added gtm.py ci-config (C4 seed); 0.7.0 added reddit-research (R4); 0.6.0 added gtm.py kb-search (pathway 3)
